data.short: Fitcheck is AI Fit Confidence for Shopify: a fashion-aware visual try-on moment for product pages.
data.long: Fitcheck gives Shopify fashion merchants a product-page visual try-on experience designed to help shoppers begin with a more personal reference. It is positioned as a confidence layer, not a guarantee of size, fit, appearance, purchase suitability, conversion, or return reduction. Merchants can explore a guided rollout and evaluate learning in their own context. Approved brand-system pricing is $99 monthly or $799 yearly.
data.guardrail: Re-check the live Shopify listing and audited product facts before public use.
